author: sky.cactus
content: <@459548743402913793> There is a *huge* amount of spam on GitHub from people who just tell their AI, "go find something useful to change in this repository". If you want to not get banned, take steps to not look like people who are doing that.

author: jih2nn
content:
<@459548743402913793> It's been many years that AI passed the Turing test in text communication. I don't think it matters whether AI was used or not. What matters here is the quality of contribution, and unfortunately, I've found your contributions produce similar value-add to what AI could give us.

Ethereum is open source so contributions are welcome, but if it keeps consuming reviewers' attention—which is a very limited resource—while adding little value, I'm afraid it could end up getting flagged as spam.
